I had the worst doctor ever. (I was in my early 20s) Over 2/3 years ago I was diagnosed with lupus and no my doctor couldn’t care less what was wrong with me. I was going to her for a year complaining about my joint paint, she said I should buy myself a wrist support… and the pain was in my whole body to the point where my mum had to help me get up out of my bed. I started loosing my hair, I had a bold patch and she responded, you have plenty of hair to cover it up. 2 months later I was bold wearing wigs. I had a rush that turned from red to purple on my thights. My tonsils were swollen, my gums were in pain, I lost my appetite and I was sleeping for 16 hour straight, as soon as I got back from work. I thought that’s how life would be now, in pain. So how did I found out I had lupus? A day before I was meant to go on a holiday to America I had the last symptom, high temperature. The ambulance took me and I had over 3000 anti bodies, it was killing me inside. All this because the GP Dr Boddke was brushing me off. I rarely went to doctors, the only reason I was still going is because my mum was forcing me to go, it was pointless as I had to end up in a hospital where they took an amazing care of me in D7 ward. She’s retired now, so I hope the practice has improved
